name: Gemini 1.5 Pro
description: Previous-gen model with 2M token context and strong multimodal ability.
longDescription: Gemini 1.5 Pro was a groundbreaking model when released, featuring a then-unprecedented 2M token context window. It excels at processing very long documents, videos, and codebases, and remains a cost-effective choice for long-context tasks.
limitations: Superseded by 2.5 Pro for most tasks
